title: Split CLI command parsing, command handlers, and WebChat server launcher
description: Keep the CLI entrypoint thin before dashboard/server flags grow by moving argument parsing, init/run/smoke commands, and WebChat server launcher code into focused modules.

files.change: Move command enum and parse helpers out of main.rs.
Group init, run, and smoke command behavior by module.
Move PendingWebChatServer/WebChatServerHandle and launch logic away from command parsing.

criteria: CLI command behavior and defaults remain unchanged.
main.rs only wires argument parsing to command execution.
WebChat server launch still uses runtime-created platform handles.
